name: switched-busreg-load-step
title: DC/DC bus regulation with a load step
purpose: Bus PRECHARGED to 400 V (the converter does not charge it), 20 kΩ load, then a parallel 10 kΩ switched in at 50 ms. BUSREG from t = 0 with the controllers starting from controlInit. Checks that the bus is back within 395–405 V over 80–100 ms.
